title: Add Qisas Hook Lab to writing
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Qisas Hook Lab](https://q8paradise.github.io/qisas-hook-lab) to writing
- Qisas Hook Lab is a bilingual Arabic/English writing workflow for developing responsible short-form stories. A user enters a subject and, after Pollinations OAuth 2.1 authorization with PKCE and BYOP,

Fixes #12905

gist.headline: Stories Find Their Hook
gist.blurb: Qisas Hook Lab has joined the writing garden. Bring a subject, connect with Pollinations using OAuth and PKCE, and grow a responsible short-form story in Arabic or English.
gist.summary: Added Qisas Hook Lab to the Pollinations writing app directory, a bilingual Arabic/English workflow that uses Pollinations OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and BYOP to develop responsible short-form stories from a user-provided subject.
gist.impact: Writers can now discover Qisas Hook Lab through the Pollinations ecosystem and use its guided bilingual story-development workflow with their own Pollinations authorization.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Qisas Hook Lab as a cozy bilingual writing desk: an open notebook contains short story hooks in Arabic and English, while Polli, wearing a tiny writer's beret, carefully tends a sprouting ink-and-code plant. A friendly retro terminal shows a small key-and-checkmark symbol for OAuth authorization, surrounded by flowers and warm paper notes.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art writing nook where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny writer's beret, tends a code-plant growing from an open notebook filled with simple Arabic and English story-hook lines; a retro terminal nearby displays a small key and checkmark for secure OAuth access. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, garden flowers, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
